ProjectGu.Combat.GuAbilityDef.label: Liquor Worm refinement
ProjectGu.Combat.GuAbilityDef.description: The Gu Master sits with the Liquor Worm circling their core while it refines their primeval essence: each pulse turns essence of their current minor stage into the same volume of the next higher quality. Stopping keeps everything already refined, and the same session can be resumed without paying again.

effectNotes.li: Refines Green Copper Primeval Essence of the cultivator's current minor stage into the next higher Rank 1 quality.
Preserves raw essence volume: each refined unit still counts as one unit of the shared capacity.
Higher-quality essence nourishes the aperture walls more efficiently (Middle 2, Upper 4, Peak 8 nourishment per unit).
Does not raise the cultivator's minor stage; advancing remains a separate act of cultivation.

limitations.li: Rank 1 apertures only. A Peak-stage cultivator has no higher Rank 1 quality to refine into.
A session is bound to the stage it began in and ends if the stage changes.
Requires an undrafted, conscious Gu Master. Drafting, another order, incapacitation or withdrawing the Gu suspends the session; completed pulses are kept and resuming is free.
